ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (black) across approximately 95% of the surface area, with high-intensity pixel clusters (white) restricted to the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white mottling located at the far lateral margins of both lobes. A series of small, isolated white circular spots are visible on the interior lower quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex and an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge, with pixel-amplitude peaks being most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a generally linear trajectory with a slight concave curvature as it approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel patterns on the distal tips, and four distinct circular marks arranged in a semi-linear pattern on the ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustations (barnacles) present on the far lateral tips of both lobes, appearing as multi-tonal, high-texture clusters of brownish-white pixels.
